newsitem.title: USA: Maritime Overseas suspends cargo loading on ship.
newsitem.headline: Maritime Overseas suspends cargo loading on ship.

text.p: Maritime Overseas Corp on Wednesday said it suspended loading cargo on an oil tanker after a sheen was spotted adjacent to the cargo tank.

The oil from the Overseas Chicago tanker, which was at the Alyeska Terminal in Valdez, Alaska, was moved to an empty tank. The company said those actions limited the volume of oil spilled to less than half a cup.
An examination of the vessel's hull showed two small cracks, one about four inches long and the other about six inches long in the No. 2 starboard cargo tank, it said.
The cracks have been temporarily repaired, and the company said the U.S. Coast Guard allowed the vessel to sail with the tank left empty.
